title: Cadence Scientific Experiment Metadata
description: Machine-readable schema for archived scientific, graphics, and physics experiments and failures.

experiment_id.description: Unique slug for the experiment in YYYY-MM-DD_slug format.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the experiment was archived.

commit_base.description: Git commit SHA from which this experiment diverged or was executed.

git_ref.description: Git branch or ref name if selective branching was used (e.g. experiments/YYYY-MM-DD_slug), or null if diff-only.

command.description: Exact command-line invocation required to reproduce the experiment.

seed.description: Deterministic PRNG seed used for the experiment.

input_data.description: Path or identifier of input dataset, mesh, or test case.

failure_mode.description: Specific failure mode (e.g. NUMERICAL_DIVERGENCE, LOSS_OF_CONSERVATION, MEMORY_OOM, DEVICE_LOST, DRIFT_INSTABILITY).

primary_subsystem.description: Primary module or subsystem under test (e.g. constraint_solver, rasterizer, integrator).

backend.description: Compute backend (e.g. CUDA, Vulkan, Metal, ROCm, CPU, OpenCL).

device_name.description: Hardware device or GPU model string.

precision.description: Floating-point precision (e.g. FP64, FP32, FP16, BFLOAT16, MIXED).

compiler_flags.description: Compiler or JIT flags used during execution.

parameters.description: Key-value dictionary of physical, algorithmic, or tuning parameters (e.g. dt, stiffness, iterations).

measurements.description: Observed diagnostic measurements, residuals, failure timestamps, or loss of conservation metrics.

untracked_artifacts.description: List of large untracked trace artifacts anchored via Content-Addressed Storage (CAS) SHA-256.

artifact_id.description: Logical identifier for the artifact (e.g. trace:residuals:csv).

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 digest of artifact contents.

hypothesis.description: Concise scientific hypothesis explaining why the approach failed or what was observed.
